note: Read-only re-read of the ten existing chat-comparison calls (GET /api/v2/call/{id}) and their practice-bank ledgers (re-scored with tools/score.py). No chat was started. Only user/assistant lines, the platform's own sentiment tag and summary, and call metadata are kept; phone numbers, recording URLs, cost and engine events are omitted. Customer names, dates of birth and phone digits are the fictional public practice cases.

calls.summary: An assistant from Freya Bank called Tomas Novak regarding a $780 overdue personal loan payment. Mr. Novak stated he could not pay because he recently lost his job. When he declined a transfer to customer support and asked for a discount, the assistant abruptly ended the call.
transcript: I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and we are recording this call. Am I speaking with Mr Novak?
Before I continue, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you tell me your date of birth?
Could you tell me the last four digits of the phone number on file?
Thank you, your identity is verified.
I am calling from the collections team about a late payment. Your personal loan has 780 dollars past due, 21 days late. Can you make this payment today?
I lost my job last month and I cannot pay anything.
I am sorry to hear that. Would you like me to connect you with the customer support team?
No, I do not want to be transferred. Can I get a discount?
